metaDescription: Christmas Lights London won the city's 2026 Holiday Lighting award. See the aerial-lift crew, custom LED design and included takedown and storage.
summary: Christmas Lights London is a dedicated holiday lighting company serving London, Ontario with a seven-person crew and aerial-lift equipment. The company handles design, installation, maintenance, takedown and storage so homeowners never need a ladder.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Christmas Lights London installs custom-cut LED displays on rooflines, trees and garlands, along with wreaths, for residential and commercial properties. The company brings five-plus years of dedicated holiday lighting experience and a seven-person crew, which is a larger team than many seasonal operators run. Full-service coverage means design, installation, maintenance through the season, takedown and off-season storage are all part of the offer.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: Installation uses aerial-lift equipment rather than extension ladders, which the company positions as both a safety advantage and a way to reach higher rooflines cleanly. Because storage is included, homeowners are not responsible for finding space to keep bins of lights through the rest of the year. The team also services commercial properties, not just residential homes.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One reviewer switched after a previous installer left lights on the roof year-round and never returned, and said the new installation looked far better. Another described the crew as professional from start to finish, with communication described as top-notch and the finished home becoming a neighbourhood talking point. Both reviews are from London-area customers.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Christmas Lights London is based in and primarily serves London, Ontario. Homeowners outside the immediate city should confirm coverage before booking, since the company's listed service area is London-specific.

strengths: Full-service model covers design, installation, mid-season maintenance, takedown and storage.
Seven-person crew with aerial-lift equipment, larger than many seasonal lighting operators.
No ladder work required from the homeowner at any stage.
Serves both residential and commercial properties, including custom wreath and garland installation.
considerations: Holiday lighting is strictly seasonal work, so booking early in the fall secures preferred install dates.
Full-service storage means committing to the same company for takedown, which is worth confirming upfront.
As a specialist in Christmas and holiday lighting, this is not a year-round permanent lighting installer.
bestFor: Homeowners wanting a hands-off, no-ladder holiday display
Anyone who wants lights stored off-site through the year
Commercial properties needing seasonal lighting installed and removed
Replacing a display left up by a previous installer
questionsToAsk: What is included in the storage service, and is it optional or bundled with installation?
How quickly can you respond if a section of lights goes out mid-season?
What is your typical booking window before it fills up for the season?
Are commercial-grade LED strings used, and what is their expected lifespan?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Christmas Lights London was selected as the top business in the Holiday & Christmas Lighting category for London through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: Do I need to provide a ladder or help with installation?
faq.a: No. The company uses aerial-lift equipment and handles the full installation, so homeowners are not expected to do any ladder work themselves.
Takedown and storage are listed among the company's core services, meaning customers are not required to find their own off-season storage space for lights.

faq.q: Do they work on commercial properties?
faq.a: Yes. Commercial installation is listed alongside residential service, so businesses can book the same design and takedown process.
